extraction_notes: Main-text NH3-synthesis performance plots digitised: Figures 1a, 1c, 1d, 3a, 4a, 4c, and 4d. Arrhenius plots (Figures 1b and 4b), DFT/characterisation/TPR/TPD/isotope/H2-only reaction panels (Figures 2, 3b–d, 5) were skipped under the instructions. Figure 4a shows clear 0.9 MPa bar only for CeN NPs; no unambiguous 0.9 MPa LaN/YN bars were digitised. Figure 1a near-zero Ni/ScN and Ni/EtN bars are not all separately recorded except the explicit Figure 3a Ni/ScN baseline point, because individual red/blue near-zero bars are not visually separable.
